templates.title: Small Business & Finance Rules
templates.tagline: Sort expenses, read invoices, and fill in fields the way your business does.
templates.proof_label: Checked exactly against your own past records
templates.needs: A spreadsheet of past examples, Excel or CSV (for example with the columns: description, category, amount). Optional: a policy document.
example_rules: category must be one of fuel, meals, software, office_supplies, travel
if the description mentions Uber then category must be travel

templates.title: Code & SQL Specialist
templates.tagline: Answer questions about your spreadsheets with SQL, or write functions that pass your tests.
templates.proof_label: Every answer is run and its result compared
templates.needs: One or more spreadsheets (Excel or CSV), or Python files with examples in their docstrings.

templates.title: Personal Docs & Legal Prep
templates.tagline: Answer questions from your leases, contracts, and paperwork, quoting the exact passage.
templates.proof_label: Every answer must quote your document word for word
templates.needs: The documents you want it to know (PDF, Word, Markdown or text).

templates.title: Custom Skill
templates.tagline: Teach any skill from examples of questions and the answers you expect.
templates.proof_label: Checked against your expected answers and your rules
templates.needs: A spreadsheet (Excel or CSV) of examples with a question column and an answer column.
